name: prompt-autopsy
description: Paste your AI chats, get a forensic readout of how you talk to machines. Static, no server, no tracking.

scripts.serve: npm run build && python3 -m http.server 8099 --directory dist
scripts.deploy: node tools/build.mjs https://prompt-autopsy.pages.dev && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=prompt-autopsy --branch=main --commit-dirty=true
